summary: Expose paged internal agent activity with explicit completeness evidence

replay.detail: Activity is derived from existing agent declarations and authoritative actual runtime evidence; no new claims are written.

schema.detail: No authoritative storage schema or client-v0 contract changes.

rules.detail: Inventory rows identify live incarnations using their own runtime and workspace observations, never cross-origin merged actual fields. A named end matches that incarnation; an unnamed end matches only the observing host. Different newer incarnations do not implicitly end older ones, which carry advisory superseded_by metadata. Unattributed evidence remains incomplete. No known live owner is not proof of filesystem or runtime absence.

compatibility.detail: The internal route and CLI return one row per live incarnation: agent id values may repeat, incarnation_id is required on complete rows, superseded_by is optional, and incomplete rows carry nullable incarnation_id and host. No client-v0 or generated client changes.

manual.detail: Use fractal agents activity --json with optional --limit, --cursor, --min-cut and --host. Accumulate all pages and evaluate completeness on the last page. min_cut is local store progress, not replication freshness. The page limit bounds the combined complete and incomplete row count, not encoded bytes.

recovery.detail: The command is read-only and leaves existing agent lifecycle operations unchanged.
